title: Fastest-lap coverage chains, contacts, and shared arithmetic alignment
status: Frozen before new lap-chain calculations; existing global behavior of these controls is known
core: Only the fastest relative runner V, original label 7
windows: All V closed safe laps W_m=[(8m+1)/(8V),(8m+7)/(8V)], m=0,...,V-1; 29 total
primary_measurements: Exact strict residual blocker interval (or empty) on every W_m, including endpoint membership and collision lap integer
Exact allowed components, positive duration, isolated contacts, active endpoint controllers and direct rational witnesses
Six single and fifteen pair durations; maximum spanning tree, exact tree bound and union equality

Deterministic interval-cover scan sorted by left endpoint, then decreasing right endpoint, then original label; record advancing right envelope, overlap/touch/gap junctions and which touching points actually survive all blockers
Normalized phase u=V*t-m and integer residues r_v(m)=v*m mod V for every lap
Full allowed set of the six fixed residual speeds alone, then its intersections with fastest safety; separate local chains from relationships across laps
Group laps by a declared qualitative blocker ordering/containment summary; record any equal summaries with different exact status, without assuming such a collision exists
independent_check: Separate event-state reconstruction, separate tree algorithm, direct witness/contact tests, independent closed-safe intersections and comparisons of every lap record

bounded_thought_experiment.scope: For each of the same V=13,16, shift ONLY speed11's normalized blocker pattern from lap m+s mod V into lap m, for every s=0,...,V-1; 29 shifted pattern arrangements total
bounded_thought_experiment.preservation: The multiset of normalized within-lap patterns and durations for every individual runner is unchanged over the V laps
bounded_thought_experiment.physical_interpretation: This is a shifted-start comparison with speed11 initial phase 11*s/V modulo1; only s=0 is the original common-start configuration. It is not a Lonely Runner counterexample or an assertion that pair moments are preserved
bounded_thought_experiment.control: Shifting ALL residual patterns together by the same lap offset only permutes lap records; require invariant total duration and contact count
bounded_thought_experiment.report: All outcomes and earliest nonzero offset changing duration or allowed-set status, if any; preserve negative result if none

hypotheses: A simple cross-lap relationship among the shared residues can explain a contact or gap; every proposed rule needs an exact sufficiency argument or an explicit failure
Unlabelled per-runner inventories may discard decisive alignment; the fixed shifted-start thought experiment tests this narrower claim
All residual intervals on a fastest lap admit an exact tree, but duration alone does not distinguish complete coverage from isolated contacts
limits: Only the two fixed speed lists and the explicitly labelled finite phase-shift thought experiment. No new speed configurations, all-reference scan, unbounded search, paid compute, outside contact, or novelty claim. General implications remain proof candidates. Changing starting phases must never be silently used to answer the common-start conjecture.
